title: Ponyta 021/195 Reverse Holo Silver Tempest Pokemon Cards TCG 2022
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Get your hands on this stunning Ponyta card from the Sword & Shield - Silver Tempest set of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. With a beautiful reverse holo finish and a card number of 021/195, this card features the Fire Horse and Fire creature types, and has an HP of 70 and an attack power of 50. The card is made from high-quality card stock and is in standard size. 

This card is perfect for collectors and players alike, and is sure to be a great addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this card, manufactured by Nintendo in the United States and illustrated by Teeziro.
